title: From Zero to We-Ro -Jason Arday
author: Shakira Dyer
observations: Repeats the public delayed-speech, literacy, autism/developmental-delay, Clapham, PE-teaching, Sandro Sandri, Black Curriculum, and decolonisation narrative.
Contains a source-version statement that Arday became Cambridge's youngest professor at age 35; this conflicts with other dated public records and is not promoted.
Contains visible typographical and wording errors, including a misspelling of Sandro Sandri's nationality and malformed prose.
Links outward to existing media, institutional, and academic sources, making it useful for propagation topology rather than independent corroboration.
evidence_boundary: No new independent record, transcript, image, video, or document binary recovered from this route.
